changelog:
Initial release of tailwindcss-toolkit-free.

- Provides essential Tailwind CSS utility class generation for personal developers.
- Supports responsive design, dark mode (class & media), and basic Tailwind configuration.
- Includes best practices for utility class writing and common usage scenarios.
- Professional features like custom plugins, design systems, and component libraries are not included in the free version.
- Setup guides and code samples for common UI components and responsive layouts are provided.
summary: Tailwind CSS实用类编写工具,涵盖响应式设计、暗黑模式与基础配置,适合个人开发者快速上手。
